_about: Canonical fact source for Animesh Mishra's two CVs (Animesh_CV.pdf and Animesh_CV_IIHMR.pdf). Edit facts here only, then run: python3 tools/cv/build_cv.py. Entries with "show": false are kept for reference but not printed. Switch one to true once the supporting certificate or document is in the repository.
headline: Pharmaceutical Product Management · Brand & Commercial Strategy · Market Research

summary.ats: MBA Pharmaceutical Management candidate at IIHMR University (2025–27) with a B.Pharm (Hons.) foundation. During a Micro Labs summer internship, built a semaglutide launch brand plan on primary field research (40-pharmacy RCPA, 10-physician survey) that shifted the strategy from share capture to category building. Pairs formulation, QC and GMP exposure with market analysis for product management and commercial-strategy roles.
summary.iihmr: MBA Pharmaceutical Management candidate with a B.Pharm (Hons.) foundation. Built a semaglutide launch brand plan during a Micro Labs summer internship, using a 40-pharmacy RCPA and a 10-physician survey to reposition the brand. Seeking product management and commercial-strategy roles that use both scientific and market evidence.

experience.role: Marketing Intern, Summer Internship Programme (Brand Management)
bullets_ats: Built GLUMIC (working brand name), an FY2026–27 launch plan for once-weekly semaglutide: a 37-slide deck covering market sizing, STP, 7P mix, pricing, KOL mapping and a three-year Excel model.

Designed and ran primary research in three Jaipur micro-markets: an RCPA of 40 pharmacies and a signed survey of 10 specialists. Found GLP-1 dispensed at only 2 of 40 outlets, and 7 of 10 physicians named cost as the main adherence barrier.

Used the findings to reposition the brand from share capture to category building. The plan targets T2DM patients with high cardiovascular risk and leads with patient support, adherence tracking and cold-chain assurance.

Sized the ₹1,906 Cr GLP-1 class (PharmaTrac, MAT May 2026) and compared tirzepatide with semaglutide. Applied CDSCO, DPCO, Schedule H and UCPMP 2024 constraints, and anchored detailing claims to SUSTAIN-6 and SELECT.
bullets_iihmr: Built a semaglutide (GLP-1) launch brand plan, GLUMIC: market sizing, STP, 7P mix, KOL mapping and a three-year Excel model.
Conducted an RCPA of 40 pharmacies and a 10-physician survey in Jaipur. Found GLP-1 dispensed at 2 of 40 outlets and cost named as the main adherence barrier by 7 of 10 physicians.
Repositioned the plan around patient support and adherence for T2DM patients with high cardiovascular risk.
Analysed IQVIA and PharmaTrac GLP-1 class data (tirzepatide vs semaglutide) within CDSCO, DPCO, Schedule H and UCPMP 2024 constraints.

bullets_iihmr: Completed a medical coding internship applying ICD-10-CM conventions to clinical documentation.

bullets_iihmr: Industrial training in QC (general instruments) and production, with exposure to HPLC, GC and UV-Vis testing and GMP documentation.
